newsitem.title: USA: US Plains cattle trade brisk at $65, up $1-feedlot.
newsitem.headline: US Plains cattle trade brisk at $65, up $1-feedlot.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets Tuesday were active at $65.00 per cwt, down $1.00 from last week, feedlot sources and USDA said.

About 12,100 head of cattle sold as of mid-afternoon in the Texas Panhandle and western Oklahoma area, with 40,000 confirmed for the week to date, which included 26,900 head formulated cattle to be shipped this week, according to USDA.
About 22,300 head sold in Kansas, with 40,600 confirmed for the week to date, including 11,000 previously contracted or formulated cattle, USDA said.
Totals were seen higher by the end of the day, they said.
